title: Verb 'to be' (am/is/are)
bridge: Na español ezali mpé biso verbó mibale: 'ser' mpe 'estar'. Na anglais ezali sékó moko: 'to be'. Molakisi ya malamu  ezali sé ékóko na español lokola na anglais tosilaki kosalela 'ser/estar' po kosala ndakisa ya makasi mpe etatí, lokola na anglais. Ndakisa ya ntina ezali sé na anglais TE ezali kobimisa mosakoli: ntina nionso ozali na bosali 'I am', 'you are', 'he is', etc.
rule: Verbe 'to be' na présent azali na makomami atatolu: 'am' (po 'I'), 'is' (po 'he, she, it') mpe 'are' (po 'you, we, they'). Po kosala mikolo, tozali kobimisa bosakoli: 'Are you...?', 'Is he...?'. Po kolanda, tozali kosala 'not': 'I am not', 'he is not' (to 'he isn't'), 'they are not' (to 'they aren't').

concept_examples.translation: Ozali na nguya? (na bosóbólí: Ozali na nguya?)

common_error.explanation: Na español tokolakaka 'Estoy cansado' na verbe ya nguya te, kasi na anglais verbe 'to be' ezali ya ntina. Kobimisa 'am/is/are' te.

examples.note: Tosalaka 'is' po mosakoli ya liboso ya singulier.
Makomami ya kopesa 'aren't' ezali ya ntina mingi na mawa.
Tosakolaka mosakoli mpe verbe po kosala mikolo.

title: Personal Pronouns (I, you, he, she, it, we, they)
bridge: Na ngala ya español, ba pronombres personales ezali mpona: yo, tú, él, ella, nosotros, vosotros, ellos. Lisusu mposa ezali ete na anglais tozali kosalela pronombre mpo na sujet, ata soki na español tokoki kobimisa yango: 'I am tired' (kasi te 'am tired'). Lokola mpe tokoki kokanga 'he' na 'she' — na anglais ezali koteya sexe ya ngomo, kasi te genre ya gramatical ya nom kifandi na español.
rule: Pronombres personales na anglais ezali: I (yo), you (tú/usted/vosotros), he (él), she (ella), it (ello), we (nosotros), they (ellos). 'It' ezali kosalema mpo na biso, mibali mpe makasi. 'You' ezali mpo na moko mpe mpo na bato mingi. Tokoki te kobimisa sujet na anglais.

common_error.correct: He is a teacher. / She is a teacher.
common_error.explanation: Na español tokolaka 'Ezali mokolo ya sika', tokokima sujet, kasi na anglais pronombre ezali ya makasi. Tokoki koloba 'He is...' to 'She is...'.

levels.label: Third person singular
levels.translation: Ntoko ya ntango ya moko ya ntoko

examples.note: Mpo na bato ya mibali na bana.

examples.translation: Bango bazali ba mama na ngai.
examples.note: Mpo na groupe ya bato to biso.
'It' ezali kosalema mpo na biso, mibali mpe makasi.

title: Ba mbalɛ ya ngɔ́ndɔ́ na ya mɔ́kɔ́lɔ́ ya ntɔ́ngɔ́
bridge: Na espanyole, tofɔlɛmba mbalɛ ya ntɔ́ngɔ́ na kosɛnga -s to -es (casa → casas, reloj → relojes). Na ngɛ́lɛ́ngɛ́, ezali mɔkɔlɔ ekateli: mpe na bato oyo bazali na -s (book → books), kasi kuna likambo mɔ́kɔ́lɔ́ ya mɔkɔlɔ: soki motuna ezali na -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z, tokosɛnga -es (bus → buses, watch → watches). Mpe kuna mbalɛ ya mɔ́kɔ́lɔ́ (child → children, foot → feet) oyo bazali na mɔkɔlɔ ya mɔkɔlɔ na bazali na likambo ya koyeba na mémoire.
rule: Likambo ya mbalɛ ya ngɔ́ndɔ́: 1) Kosɛnga -s (cat → cats). 2) Kosɛnga -es soki motuna ezali na -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z (box → boxes, dish → dishes). 3) Soki ezali na -y na limɔ́tshi ya ntɔ́ngɔ́, kobimisa -y na -ies (city → cities). 4) Soki ezali na -f to -fe, mbala mosusu kobimisa na -ves (wolf → wolves, knife → knives). Mbalɛ ya mɔ́kɔ́lɔ́ ezali makasi: child → children, foot → feet, tooth → teeth, man → men, woman → women, mouse → mice, sheep → sheep (mɔkɔlɔ), fish → fish (mɔkɔlɔ ya mɔkɔlɔ).

common_error.explanation: Na espanyole, nionso mbalɛ ezali ya ngɔ́ndɔ́ (niño → niños), kasi na ngɛ́lɛ́ngɛ́ 'child' ezali ya mɔ́kɔ́lɔ́ na mbalɛ na ye ezali 'children'. Ezali likɔ́bɔ́ ya mɔkɔlɔ mingi ya ba oyo bazali koyeba espanyole na koyekola likambo ya kosɛnga -s.

title: Presente simple (I eat, you eat, he eats)
bridge: Na español, tosilaka presente simple mpo na biso bokoluka makambo otalela: 'Yo como pizza todos los días'. Na anglais ezali mpe moko, kasi na ndakisa moko ya likolo: na motuya mwa moke (he, she, it) tosali -s na verbe (he eats, she works). Mpe tokoki kosala na 'do/does' mpo na botungi na bosukoli, lokola na español tosilaka '¿...?' na ndakisa, kasi awa ezali ya solo.
rule: Presente simple esalemi na verbe ya mawa mpo na bato nionso malonga motuya mwa moke ya sika moko (he, she, it), kasi tosalaka -s (to -es soki ekomaka na -s, -sh, -ch, -x, -z). Mpo na botungi na bosukoli tosilaka 'do' (mpo na I, you, we, they) to 'does' (mpo na he, she, it) + verbe ya mawa (moko -s). Ex: 'I eat', 'He eats', 'Do you eat?', 'She doesn't eat'.

concept_examples.translation: Nazali kosala mokolo na 8 na ngonga.

common_error.explanation: Na español, motuya mwa moke ya sika moko ezali na likambo moko te na presente (él come), kasi na anglais tosalaka ntina -s ntina (he eats). Oyo ezali ndakisa moko ya likolo ya kopesa ba hispanohablantes.

examples.original: She reads a book every day.

translations.ln: Presente simple (I eat, you eat, he eats)

title: Adverbios de frecuencia (always, sometimes, never)
bridge: Na español, bango ya koposa oyo ezali 'siempre', 'a veces' mpe 'nunca' ekoki kozala na liboso ya verba: 'Yo siempre como pizza' to na nsuka ya verba na mikakatano misusu. Na anglais, pozision ezali mpenza: kokoluka kozala na liboso ya verba ya solo (I always eat pizza), kasi na nsuka ya verba 'to be' (I am always tired). Lisusu oyo ekoki kozala ezali ete na español tokoki kobonga yango na nsuka ya lokuta, kasi na anglais oyo ekoki kozala mawa te.
rule: Bango ya koposa oyo ekoki kozala mpenza ezali: always (siempre), usually (normalmente), often (a menudo), sometimes (a veces), rarely (raramente), never (nunca). Bakokani kozala na LIBOSO ya verba ya solo (I always go to school), kasi na NSUKA ya verba 'to be' (I am always happy). Na bilongi, bakokani kozala na nsuka ya sujet (Do you always eat breakfast?)

concept_examples.text: I always drink coffee in the morning.
concept_examples.translation: Nazali kosepela café na ntango ya zonga.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz drɪŋk ˈkɒfi ɪn ðə ˈmɔːnɪŋ/

concept_examples.translation: Yande akoki kozala na nsuka te.

concept_examples.text: They sometimes go to the cinema.
concept_examples.translation: Bango bazali koyebisa yango na kino.
Oyebi kozala na kati ya yango?

common_error.explanation: Na español tokoloba 'Yo siempre como pizza' to 'Yo como pizza siempre'. Na anglais, bango ya koposa ekoki kozala na LIBOSO ya verba ya solo (always eat). Kobonga yango na nsuka ekoki kozala mawa te.

examples.original: I always get up at 7 am.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈɔːlweɪz ɡet ʌp æt ˈsevən æm/

examples.note: Bango ekoki kozala na NSUKA ya verba 'to be'.

title: Have got / Has got
bridge: Na español, po na komona ete tozali na nkombo ya 'tener': 'Yo tengo un coche'. Na anglais, kaka mibale: 'have' (I have a car) mpe 'have got' (I have got a car). 'Have got' ezali pona na anglais ya britannique mpe tozali kosalela yango na makambo oyo ezali ya nguya. Structure ezali ya moke, kasi 'have got' ezali kosalema na ntango ya présent. Na négatif mpe na botiki, 'have got' ezali kosalema na 'have' direktè, te 'do/does'. Mwa exemple: 'I haven't got a car' mpe 'Have you got a car?'.
rule: Have got / Has got ezali kosalema pona komona ete tozali na nkombo, makambo oyo tozali na yango, makambo oyo tozali na yango na molongo mpe makambo oyo tozali na yango na nguya. Afirmatif: I/you/we/they have got, he/she/it has got. Négatif: I/you/we/they have not got (haven't got), he/she/it has not got (hasn't got). Botiki: Have I/you/we/they got? Has he/she/it got? Tozali kosalema te 'do/does'. Na botiki ya motuya: Yes, I have / No, I haven't. Tozali kosalela yango na ntango ya présent; pona ntango nalingi, tozali kosalema 'have' kaka moko.

concept_examples.text: I have got a new phone.

concept_examples.translation: Yande azali na mitú ya ble.

common_error.explanation: Na español, 'tener' ezali kopesa na 'have' to 'have got'. Kasi 'have got' ezali kosalema na 'got', te 'get'. Koloba 'I have get' ezali likambo oyo ezali na ntina mingi ata mpe tozali kopesa yango na infinitif. Kolinga: 'have got' ezali pona komona ete tozali na nkombo na ntango ya présent.

examples.original: We have got a big house.
examples.note: Tozali kosalela 'have got' pona komona ete tozali na nkombo.
Tozali kosalela 'has got' pona moto ya moko.
Botiki ezali kopesa na kosala 'have/has' mpe moto.

title: Preposiciones de lugar (in, on, under, next to)
bridge: Na español, tosilaka mbula 'en' na nsoni ya makasi: 'en la casa', 'en la mesa', 'en la calle'. Na anglais, kaka preposiciones ya makasi ya esika mpe kozonga na esika te. 'In' tosilaka yango na esika ya mbula to ya mibeko misato (in the room), 'on' na esika ya makita (on the table), 'under' na esika ya nsé (under the bed) mpe 'next to' na esika ya kotalela (next to the door). Kaka kosala mpe ete 'en la esquina' tokolaka 'on the corner' (te 'in').
rule: Preposiciones ya esika ya mwa ntango: in (na nse), on (na makita), under (na nsé), next to (na kotalela). Mpe: behind (na mbela), in front of (na zule), between (na kati ya mibali). Na anglais ya anglais, na lokwa tokolaka 'on the bus', 'on the train', kasi 'in the car'. Na mikolo: 'Where is the cat?' → 'It is under the table.'

concept_examples.text: The book is on the table.
The cat is under the bed.
concept_examples.translation: Mwana ya mbwa azali na nsé ya salata.

concept_examples.text: The supermarket is next to the bank.
concept_examples.translation: Supermarcé azali na kotalela ya banco.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈsuːpəmɑːkɪt ɪz nekst tə ðə bæŋk/

common_error.explanation: Na español tokolaka 'en el autobús' na nsoni ya makasi, kasi na anglais, na lokwa ya mbula (bus, train, plane), tosilaka 'on', te 'in'. 'In' tosilaka yango na lokwa ya moto mpe taxi (in the car).

examples.original: The milk is in the fridge.
The keys are on the table.
examples.translation: Bana ezali na makita ya mesa.

examples.original: My shoes are under the chair.
examples.translation: Sapato na yango ezali na nsé ya chaise.

examples.original: The school is next to the church.
examples.phonetic: /ðə skuːl ɪz nekst tə ðə tʃɜːtʃ/
examples.translation: École ezali na kotalela ya église.
examples.note: Tosilaka 'next to' na esika ya kotalela.

translations.ln: Preposiciones de lugar (in, on, under, next to)

title: Bimisa (this, that, these, those)
bridge: Na español, topesani 'este' (kɔlɔngɔ), 'ese' (mbula mwa mwa) mpe 'aquel' (mbula mingi). Na anglais ezali ndambo mibale: 'this' (singulier) mpe 'these' (pluriel) kɔlɔngɔ; 'that' (singulier) mpe 'those' (pluriel) mbula. Likambo ya mawa ya kopesa ba lokɔlɔ ya español ezali basili kozonga 'ese' mpe 'aquel' na anglais, mpe bazali kosalela 'this' na nko na nko ya maye basengi, ata soki ezali mbula.
rule: Tosalela 'this' na biso kɔlɔngɔ (singulier). Tosalela 'these' na biso kɔlɔngɔ (pluriel). Tosalela 'that' mbula (singulier). Tosalela 'those' mbula (pluriel). Tosalela yango na kosala présentation: 'This is my friend' (soki azali kɔlɔngɔ) mpe 'That is my house' (soki tozali kosɛngela mbula).

common_error.explanation: Na español, 'este' mpe 'estos' ezali mibalé, kasi ba lokɔlɔ ya español bazali kosalela 'this' na pluriel na ngala, to bazali kozonga lokuta ya 'these' /ðiːz/ mpe 'this' /ðɪs/. Boye, 'this' ezali singulier mpe 'these' ezali pluriel.

title: Can (bosolo mpe bokomi)
bridge: Na español, tosilaka 'poder' mpo na kosalela bosolo ('puedo nadar') mpe bokomi ('¿puedo ir?'). Na anglais, 'can' ezali na boswa na misato ya kozonga. Likolo ya mpenza ezali ete 'can' akoyekola te na moto ya moke (he can, she can) mpe akosenga te 'to' sima (I can swim, te 'I can to swim'). Kuna mpe, mpo na biloko mpe kobenga tozali kosalela te 'do/does' kasi tozali kobimisa boswa (Can you swim?) tozali kosalela 'not' (I cannot / can't). Ezali bosolo ya modal, kasi ezali kozonga na sima ya bosolo ya infinitif na 'to'.
rule: 'Can' ezali kosalema mpo na: 1) bosolo (I can play the piano), 2) bokomi (Can I go to the bathroom?), 3) boswana (It can rain tomorrow). Ezali ya kozonga mpo na bato nionso. Afirmatif: I/you/he/she/it/we/they can + bosolo ya mawa. Négatif: cannot (can't) + bosolo ya mawa. Biloko: Can + moto + bosolo ya mawa? Biloko ya kokamba: Yes, I can / No, I can't.

concept_examples.translation: Yande azali koyeba lolenge ya mibale ya lokota.
Yande azali kosala te makasi ya kokamba.

common_error.explanation: Na español tosilaka 'puedo cantar' na likambo ya kozonga. Na anglais, 'can' ezali kozonga na sima ya bosolo ya infinitif NA 'to'. Koloba 'can to' ezali likambo moko ya mabe mpenza mpo na kozonga na bosolo nionso ya kozonga na 'to' (want to, need to).

examples.translation: Yande azali koyeba te makasi naye.

examples.original: Can they come? Yes, they can.
examples.translation: Bazali kosala biso moko te? Eh, bazali.
examples.note: Biloko ya kozonga mpe biloko ya kokamba.

title: Boyokele na 'wh-' (nini, wapi, nani, kashini)
bridge: Na espanyol, toboyi boyokele na mibalé moko ya 'qué', 'dónde', 'quién', 'cuándo'. Na ngala ya anglais ezali moke: 'what' (nini), 'where' (wapi), 'who' (nani), 'when' (kashini). Lisalisi ezali: Mbalé ya wh- + mbalé ya kobika (to mbalé 'to be') + motó + mbalé ya ntina? Kifuanzu: 'Where do you live?' (Ozali kosala wapi?). Bosaleli ya lingala ezali kobimisa mbalé ya 'do/does' na ntango ya bosolo, mpe kobenga kozonga lisalisi na boyokele ya kozonga (kotiá na 'Can you tell me where the station is?' – ezali malamu, te 'where is the station' na boyokele ya kozonga).
rule: Boyokele ya wh- ekomími na ndenge wana: 1) Na mbalé 'to be': Mbalé ya wh- + am/is/are + motó? (Wapi banki ezali?). 2) Na 'can': Mbalé ya wh- + can + motó + mbalé? (Nini ozali kokoka kosala?). 3) Na bosolo (mibalé mosusu): Mbalé ya wh- + do/does + motó + mbalé ya ntina? (Nini ozali koya?). 4) Na boyokele ya kozonga (simá 'Can you tell me...', 'Do you know...'), lisalisi ezali motó + mbalé (kozonga te): 'Can you tell me where the station is?' (te 'where is the station').

common_error.wrong: Can you tell me where is the station?
common_error.correct: Can you tell me where the station is?
common_error.explanation: Na espanyol, na boyokele ya kozonga tozali kobenga lisalisi ya boyokele ya kozonga: '¿Puedes decirme dónde está la estación?'. Na ngala ya anglais, na boyokele ya kozonga, lisalisi ezali motó + mbalé, kozanga kozonga. Ezali bosaleli moko ya mbi ya bayekoli ya lingala.

title: There is / Kuna
bridge: Na nsuka ya español, mpo na koloba 'kuna', topesaka motuna moko: 'hay'. Na anglais, kuna biloko mibiri: 'there is' (moko) mpe 'there are' (mibalé). Bosangani ezali na mokolo ya liboso ya motuna oyo ezali na nsé. Mpo na ndakisa: 'There is a book on the table' (Kuna bukí moko kuna mbalé), 'There are two books on the table' (Kuna bukí mibiri kuna mbalé). Ezali na bosungi mpe na biloko oyo tozali kopusa: 'Is there a bank near here?' mpe 'Are there any restaurants?'. Bosósi mpo na bato oyo balobaka español ezali kopesa 'there is/are' mpe 'have' (balobi 'The house has a garden' na esika ya 'There is a garden in the house').
rule: Topesaka 'There is' mpo na mituna oyo tozali kobenga na moko mpe oyo tapezwa te (There is some water). Topesaka 'There are' mpo na mituna oyo tozali kobenga na mibalé (There are three chairs). Na biloko oyo tozali kopusa: Is there...? / Are there...? Na biloko oyo tapezwa te: There isn't / There aren't. Topesaka mpe na 'any' na biloko oyo tozali kopusa mpe oyo tapezwa te: 'Is there any milk?' (Kuna boye?) mpe 'There isn't any milk' (Kuna boye te).

concept_examples.text: There is a cat in the garden.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə kæt ɪn ðə ˈɡɑːdən/

concept_examples.text: There are two chairs in the kitchen.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːr tuː tʃeəz ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn/

concept_examples.text: Is there a bank near here?
There aren't any students in the class.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːnt ˈeni ˈstjuːdənts ɪn ðə klɑːs/

common_error.wrong: In my house have a garden.
common_error.correct: There is a garden in my house.
common_error.explanation: Na nsuka ya español tolobaka 'Mi casa tiene un jardín' na ntina ya 'tener', kasi na anglais, mpo na koloba ete kuna, topesaka 'there is/are', te 'have'. Ezali bosósi mpo na traduction ya mot à mot. Tokoki koloba 'My house has a garden' (tener) koko 'there is' ezali na bosungi mpo na koloba ete kuna na esika moko.

examples.original: There is a phone on the desk.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɪz ə fəʊn ɒn ðə desk/

examples.original: There are three cars in the street.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ɑːr θriː kɑːrz ɪn ðə striːt/

levels.label: Questions with Is there / Are there
levels.translation: Biloko oyo tozali kopusa na Is there / Are there

examples.original: Are there any eggs in the fridge?
examples.phonetic: /ɑːr ðeər ˈeni eɡz ɪn ðə frɪdʒ/

levels.label: Negative with isn't / aren't
levels.translation: Biloko oyo tapezwa te na isn't / aren't

examples.original: There isn't any sugar in the cupboard.
examples.phonetic: /ðeər ˈɪzənt ˈeni ˈʃʊɡər ɪn ðə ˈkʌbəd/
examples.note: Biloko oyo tapezwa te na 'any' mpo na oyo tapezwa te.
